question: Which five departure airports have the widest variety of aircraft types scheduled in October 2026? Return airport codes, names, and aircraft type counts, most types first, then by airport code.
reference_sql: SELECT a~airport_id, a~name, COUNT( DISTINCT f~plane_type_id ) AS aircraft_type_count FROM /dmo/airport AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS c ON c~airport_from_id = a~airport_id INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id AND f~connection_id = c~connection_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY a~airport_id, a~name ORDER BY aircraft_type_count DESCENDING, a~airport_id ASCENDING UP TO 5 ROWS

question: Which 10 airport pairs have the most occupied seats across flights in the fourth quarter of 2026, keeping each direction separate? Return departure and arrival airport codes, flight counts, and total occupied seats, most occupied seats first, then by departure and arrival code.
reference_sql: SELECT c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM( f~seats_occupied ) AS occupied_seats FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id AND f~connection_id = c~connection_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261231' GROUP BY c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id ORDER BY occupied_seats DESCENDING, c~airport_from_id ASCENDING, c~airport_to_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Show the 10 agencies handling the most trips, with their IDs, names, total trip counts, and separate counts of new, planned, and booked trips. Sort by total trips, highest first, then by agency ID.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS new_trip_count, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS planned_trip_count, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trip_count FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 passengers have the most add-on entries attached to their flight bookings? Return customer IDs, first and last names, add-on entry counts, and counts of different add-ons, most entries first, then by customer ID.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT(*) AS addon_entry_count, COUNT( DISTINCT s~supplement_id ) AS distinct_addon_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS s ON s~travel_id = b~travel_id AND s~booking_id = b~booking_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY addon_entry_count DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 departure airports have the most connections to another country, considering only airports with at least one such connection? Count each airline's numbered connection separately. Return airport codes, names, and connection counts, most connections first, then by airport code.
reference_sql: SELECT origin~airport_id, origin~name, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS origin ON origin~airport_id = c~airport_from_id INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS destination ON destination~airport_id = c~airport_to_id WHERE origin~country <> destination~country GROUP BY origin~airport_id, origin~name ORDER BY connection_count DESCENDING, origin~airport_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 destination airports have flight bookings through the most different travel agencies? Return airport codes, agency counts, and distinct trip counts, most agencies first, then by airport code.
reference_sql: SELECT c~airport_to_id, COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) AS agency_count, COUNT( DISTINCT t~travel_id ) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id AND c~connection_id = b~connection_id GROUP BY c~airport_to_id ORDER BY agency_count DESCENDING, c~airport_to_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 add-ons appear on bookings with the widest range of airlines? Return add-on codes, category codes, and airline counts, most airlines first, then by add-on code.
reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_id, s~supplement_category, COUNT( DISTINCT b~carrier_id ) AS airline_count FROM /dmo/supplement AS s INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS bs ON bs~supplement_id = s~supplement_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = bs~travel_id AND b~booking_id = bs~booking_id GROUP BY s~supplement_id, s~supplement_category ORDER BY airline_count DESCENDING, s~supplement_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 flights in November 2026 have the most recorded flight bookings? Return airline codes and names, connection numbers, flight dates, booking counts, and recorded occupied seats, most bookings first, then by date, airline code, and connection number.
reference_sql: SELECT f~carrier_id, c~name, f~connection_id, f~flight_date, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, f~seats_occupied FROM /dmo/flight AS f INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND b~connection_id = f~connection_id AND b~flight_date = f~flight_date WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261101' AND '20261130' GROUP BY f~carrier_id, c~name, f~connection_id, f~flight_date, f~seats_occupied ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, f~flight_date ASCENDING, f~carrier_id ASCENDING, f~connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 passengers have the highest single flight booking charges in euros? Return customer IDs, first and last names, and each passenger's highest euro flight charge, highest charge first, then by customer ID.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, MAX( b~flight_price ) AS highest_euro_charge FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id WHERE b~currency_code = 'EUR' GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY highest_euro_charge DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Show the first 10 scheduled departures from Frankfurt airport (FRA) in October 2026. Return airline codes and names, connection numbers, flight dates, departure times, and destination airport codes, earliest date and time first, then by airline code and connection number.
reference_sql: SELECT f~carrier_id, a~name, f~connection_id, f~flight_date, c~departure_time, c~airport_to_id FROM /dmo/flight AS f INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND c~connection_id = f~connection_id INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS a ON a~carrier_id = f~carrier_id WHERE c~airport_from_id = 'FRA' AND f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' ORDER BY f~flight_date ASCENDING, c~departure_time ASCENDING, f~carrier_id ASCENDING, f~connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: For each trip starting in October 2026, show its first flight booking, choosing the lowest booking number if several were made on the same day. Return the trip number, booking number, booking date, flight date, airline name, price, and currency.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, b~booking_id, b~booking_date, b~flight_date, c~name, b~flight_price, b~currency_code FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t INNER JOIN /DMO/BOOKING AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /DMO/CARRIER AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /DMO/BOOKING AS earlier WHERE earlier~travel_id = b~travel_id AND ( earlier~booking_date < b~booking_date OR ( earlier~booking_date = b~booking_date AND earlier~booking_id < b~booking_id ) ) )

question: For trips starting in June 2026, how many lasted under 7 days, 7 to 13 days, or at least 14 days? Return each status code and the three counts, measuring duration as the days between start and end.
reference_sql: SELECT t~status, SUM( CASE WHEN dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) < 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS under_7_days, SUM( CASE WHEN dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS days_7_to_13, SUM( CASE WHEN dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS at_least_14_days FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20260601' AND '20260630' GROUP BY t~status

question: For each airline flying in October 2026, how many scheduled flights used aircraft with under 300 seats, and how many used aircraft with at least 300 seats? Return airline codes, names, and both counts.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, SUM( CASE WHEN f~seats_max < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS under_300_seats, SUM( CASE WHEN f~seats_max >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS at_least_300_seats FROM /DMO/FLIGHT AS f INNER JOIN /DMO/CARRIER AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name

question: For each type of purchased extra, how many purchases belong to booked, planned, and new trips? Return the extra type code and the three purchase counts.
reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_category, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trip_purchases, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS planned_trip_purchases, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS new_trip_purchases FROM /DMO/BOOK_SUPPL AS bs INNER JOIN /DMO/SUPPLEMENT AS s ON s~supplement_id = bs~supplement_id INNER JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL AS t ON t~travel_id = bs~travel_id GROUP BY s~supplement_category

question: For each destination country served in October 2026, how many scheduled flights departed from Germany and how many departed from other countries? Return destination country codes and both flight counts.
reference_sql: SELECT destination~country, SUM( CASE WHEN origin~country = 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS flights_from_germany, SUM( CASE WHEN origin~country <> 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS flights_from_elsewhere FROM /DMO/FLIGHT AS f INNER JOIN /DMO/CONNECTION AS r ON r~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND r~connection_id = f~connection_id INNER JOIN /DMO/AIRPORT AS origin ON origin~airport_id = r~airport_from_id INNER JOIN /DMO/AIRPORT AS destination ON destination~airport_id = r~airport_to_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY destination~country

question: Which 20 flight bookings for departures in December 2026 were made furthest in advance? Return trip and booking numbers, airline names, booking and flight dates, and days in advance. Sort by days in advance, highest first, then by trip and booking number.
reference_sql: SELECT b~travel_id, b~booking_id, c~name, b~booking_date, b~flight_date, dats_days_between( b~booking_date, b~flight_date ) AS days_in_advance FROM /DMO/BOOKING AS b INNER JOIN /DMO/CARRIER AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id WHERE b~flight_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' ORDER BY days_in_advance DESCENDING, b~travel_id ASCENDING, b~booking_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which customers have used both an agency in their own country and an agency abroad? Return customer numbers, first and last names, and country codes.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, c~country_code FROM /DMO/CUSTOMER AS c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS domestic_trip INNER JOIN /DMO/AGENCY AS domestic_agency ON domestic_agency~agency_id = domestic_trip~agency_id WHERE domestic_trip~customer_id = c~customer_id AND domestic_agency~country_code = c~country_code ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS foreign_trip INNER JOIN /DMO/AGENCY AS foreign_agency ON foreign_agency~agency_id = foreign_trip~agency_id WHERE foreign_trip~customer_id = c~customer_id AND foreign_agency~country_code <> c~country_code )

question: For trips starting in October 2026 with at least two euro-priced flight bookings, show the trip number, number of those bookings, cheapest and most expensive booking prices, and their price difference in euros. Sort by price difference, largest first, then by trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, COUNT(*) AS euro_booking_count, MIN( b~flight_price ) AS cheapest_booking_eur, MAX( b~flight_price ) AS most_expensive_booking_eur, MAX( b~flight_price ) - MIN( b~flight_price ) AS price_difference_eur FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t INNER JOIN /DMO/BOOKING AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' AND b~currency_code = 'EUR' GROUP BY t~travel_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY price_difference_eur DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING

question: Which 20 trips with the lowest trip numbers contain flights in both directions between the same two airports? Return trip numbers and the trip customers' numbers, first names, and last names, sorted by trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t INNER JOIN /DMO/CUSTOMER AS c ON c~customer_id = t~customer_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /DMO/BOOKING AS b1 INNER JOIN /DMO/CONNECTION AS r1 ON r1~carrier_id = b1~carrier_id AND r1~connection_id = b1~connection_id INNER JOIN /DMO/BOOKING AS b2 ON b2~travel_id = b1~travel_id INNER JOIN /DMO/CONNECTION AS r2 ON r2~carrier_id = b2~carrier_id AND r2~connection_id = b2~connection_id WHERE b1~travel_id = t~travel_id AND r2~airport_from_id = r1~airport_to_id AND r2~airport_to_id = r1~airport_from_id ) ORDER BY t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: For October 2026 flights, how many cost under 500, from 500 to under 1,000, or at least 1,000 in their listed currency? Return each currency and the three flight counts, keeping currencies separate.
reference_sql: SELECT f~currency_code, SUM( CASE WHEN f~price < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS under_500, SUM( CASE WHEN f~price >= 500 AND f~price < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS from_500_to_under_1000, SUM( CASE WHEN f~price >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS at_least_1000 FROM /DMO/FLIGHT AS f WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY f~currency_code

question: Show the 10 flights with the fewest unoccupied seats, including airline codes, route numbers, dates and unoccupied seat counts. Sort by unoccupied seats, fewest first, then date, airline code and route number.
reference_sql: SELECT carrier_id, connection_id, flight_date, seats_max - seats_occupied AS unoccupied_seats FROM /dmo/flight ORDER BY unoccupied_seats ASCENDING, flight_date ASCENDING, carrier_id ASCENDING, connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: On which 5 dates were the most flight bookings made? Show booking dates and booking counts, largest count first, then earliest date.
reference_sql: SELECT booking_date, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/booking GROUP BY booking_date ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, booking_date ASCENDING UP TO 5 ROWS

question: Which 10 airline routes have the most flight bookings? Show airline codes, route numbers and booking counts, largest count first, then airline code and route number.
reference_sql: SELECT carrier_id, connection_id, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/booking GROUP BY carrier_id, connection_id ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, carrier_id ASCENDING, connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many available extras are in each category? Show category codes and extra counts.
reference_sql: SELECT supplement_category, COUNT(*) AS extra_count FROM /dmo/supplement GROUP BY supplement_category

question: Which 5 countries have the most airports listed? Show country codes and airport counts, largest count first, then country code.
reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM /dmo/airport GROUP BY country ORDER BY airport_count DESCENDING, country ASCENDING UP TO 5 ROWS

question: How many airline routes are listed in total?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM /dmo/connection

question: Which 10 customers have the most trips? Show customer numbers and trip counts, largest count first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/travel GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many trips start on each date in October 2026? Show start dates and trip counts, earliest date first.
reference_sql: SELECT begin_date, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/travel WHERE begin_date >= '20261001' AND begin_date < '20261101' GROUP BY begin_date ORDER BY begin_date ASCENDING

question: Which 10 airlines have flight bookings through the most different travel agencies? Return airline codes, names, and agency counts, most agencies first, then by airline code.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) AS agency_count FROM /DMO/CARRIER AS c INNER JOIN /DMO/BOOKING AS b ON b~carrier_id = c~carrier_id INNER JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL AS t ON t~travel_id = b~travel_id GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name ORDER BY agency_count DESCENDING, c~carrier_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 passenger home cities account for the most flight bookings? Return city names, country codes, booking counts, and distinct passenger counts, most bookings first, then by country code and city name.
reference_sql: SELECT c~city, c~country_code, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, COUNT( DISTINCT c~customer_id ) AS passenger_count FROM /DMO/CUSTOMER AS c INNER JOIN /DMO/BOOKING AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~city, c~country_code ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, c~country_code ASCENDING, c~city ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: What are the lowest and highest catalog prices in each add-on category and currency with at least one catalog entry? Return category codes, currencies, and both prices.
reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_category, s~currency_code, MIN( s~price ) AS lowest_price, MAX( s~price ) AS highest_price FROM /DMO/SUPPLEMENT AS s GROUP BY s~supplement_category, s~currency_code

question: For each agency handling trips starting in October 2026, show its ID, name, earliest trip start date, and latest trip end date.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, MIN( t~begin_date ) AS earliest_start, MAX( t~end_date ) AS latest_end FROM /DMO/AGENCY AS a INNER JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name

question: For each airline and aircraft type scheduled in January 2027, show the airline code and name, aircraft type, and number of different connections served.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, f~plane_type_id, COUNT( DISTINCT f~connection_id ) AS connection_count FROM /DMO/CARRIER AS c INNER JOIN /DMO/FLIGHT AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20270101' AND '20270131' GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name, f~plane_type_id

question: How are purchased add-ons distributed across trip statuses? For each add-on category and trip status with purchased add-ons, return both codes, the number of add-on entries, and the number of distinct trips.
reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_category, t~status, COUNT(*) AS addon_count, COUNT( DISTINCT t~travel_id ) AS trip_count FROM /DMO/BOOK_SUPPL AS bs INNER JOIN /DMO/SUPPLEMENT AS s ON s~supplement_id = bs~supplement_id INNER JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL AS t ON t~travel_id = bs~travel_id GROUP BY s~supplement_category, t~status

question: For each trip status and currency, show the status code, currency, number of trips, and lowest and highest booking fees.
reference_sql: SELECT t~status, t~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, MIN( t~booking_fee ) AS lowest_fee, MAX( t~booking_fee ) AS highest_fee FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t GROUP BY t~status, t~currency_code

question: Which 10 booking dates had the most flight bookings? Return the dates, booking counts, and distinct passenger counts, most bookings first, then by date.
reference_sql: SELECT b~booking_date, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, COUNT( DISTINCT b~customer_id ) AS passenger_count FROM /DMO/BOOKING AS b GROUP BY b~booking_date ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, b~booking_date ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: For each departure country in October 2026, how many different airlines and aircraft types are scheduled to fly from it? Return country codes and both counts.
reference_sql: SELECT a~country, COUNT( DISTINCT f~carrier_id ) AS airline_count, COUNT( DISTINCT f~plane_type_id ) AS aircraft_type_count FROM /DMO/FLIGHT AS f INNER JOIN /DMO/CONNECTION AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND c~connection_id = f~connection_id INNER JOIN /DMO/AIRPORT AS a ON a~airport_id = c~airport_from_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY a~country

question: Which customers have at least two trips, all with the same status? Return customer numbers, first and last names, the status code, and trip count.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, MIN( t~status ) AS status_code, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT( DISTINCT t~status ) = 1

question: Which airport-to-airport routes had flights from at least two airlines in October 2026? Treat each direction separately. Return departure and arrival airport codes, airline counts, and scheduled flight counts.
reference_sql: SELECT c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id, COUNT( DISTINCT f~carrier_id ) AS airline_count, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id AND f~connection_id = c~connection_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT f~carrier_id ) >= 2

question: For each airline that had flights in September or October 2026, what percentage of its scheduled seats were occupied in September 2026 and in October 2026? Calculate each percentage from the month's total occupied seats and total capacity, rounded to 2 decimals. Return airline codes, names, and both percentages.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, DIVISION( SUM( CASE WHEN f~flight_date BETWEEN '20260901' AND '20260930' THEN f~seats_occupied ELSE 0 END ) * 100, SUM( CASE WHEN f~flight_date BETWEEN '20260901' AND '20260930' THEN f~seats_max ELSE 0 END ), 2 ) AS september_occupied_pct, DIVISION( SUM( CASE WHEN f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' THEN f~seats_occupied ELSE 0 END ) * 100, SUM( CASE WHEN f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' THEN f~seats_max ELSE 0 END ), 2 ) AS october_occupied_pct FROM /dmo/carrier AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20260901' AND '20261031' GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name

question: Which trips starting in October 2026 have booked flights on at least two different dates? Return trip numbers, first and last flight dates, and the number of days between those dates.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, MIN( b~flight_date ) AS first_flight_date, MAX( b~flight_date ) AS last_flight_date, DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN( MIN( b~flight_date ), MAX( b~flight_date ) ) AS flight_span_days FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY t~travel_id HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT b~flight_date ) >= 2

question: Which 20 euro-priced trips starting in June 2026 have the highest total price per calendar day, counting both the start and end dates? Return trip numbers, start and end dates, total prices, and prices per day rounded to 2 decimals. Sort by the rounded daily price, highest first, then by trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~begin_date, t~end_date, t~total_price, DIVISION( t~total_price, DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) + 1, 2 ) AS price_per_day_eur FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20260601' AND '20260630' AND t~currency_code = 'EUR' ORDER BY price_per_day_eur DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which trips starting in October 2026 include purchased extras from at least two categories? Return trip numbers, the number of extra categories, and the number of purchased extras.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, COUNT( DISTINCT s~supplement_category ) AS category_count, COUNT(*) AS extra_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS bs ON bs~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/supplement AS s ON s~supplement_id = bs~supplement_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY t~travel_id HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT s~supplement_category ) >= 2

question: For flights departing in December 2026, what are the total flight-booking charges attached to booked, planned, and new trips? Return airline codes, names, currencies, and the three charge totals, keeping currencies separate.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, b~currency_code, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN b~flight_price ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trip_charges, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'P' THEN b~flight_price ELSE 0 END ) AS planned_trip_charges, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN b~flight_price ELSE 0 END ) AS new_trip_charges FROM /dmo/booking AS b INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~travel_id = b~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id WHERE b~flight_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name, b~currency_code

question: For each trip status, what percentage of trips starting in the fourth quarter of 2026 start in December? Return status codes, quarter trip counts, December trip counts, and percentages rounded to 2 decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT t~status, COUNT(*) AS quarter_trip_count, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS december_trip_count, DIVISION( SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100, COUNT(*), 2 ) AS december_percentage FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261231' GROUP BY t~status

question: For trips starting in April 2027, how much of the total trip price comes from booking fees? Return each currency, total booking fees, total trip prices, and booking fees as a percentage of total trip prices, rounded to 2 decimals. Keep currencies separate.
reference_sql: SELECT t~currency_code, SUM( t~booking_fee ) AS total_booking_fees, SUM( t~total_price ) AS total_trip_prices, DIVISION( SUM( t~booking_fee ) * 100, SUM( t~total_price ), 2 ) AS booking_fee_percentage FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20270401' AND '20270430' GROUP BY t~currency_code

question: What are the earliest and latest recorded booking dates?
reference_sql: SELECT MIN( booking_date ) AS earliest_booking_date, MAX( booking_date ) AS latest_booking_date FROM /DMO/BOOKING

question: Which 10 agencies have served the most distinct customers? Show agency numbers and customer counts, highest count first, then by agency number.
reference_sql: SELECT agency_id, COUNT( DISTINCT customer_id ) AS customer_count FROM /DMO/TRAVEL GROUP BY agency_id ORDER BY customer_count DESCENDING, agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many different destination airports can be reached directly from each departure airport that has listed connections? Show departure airport codes and destination counts.
reference_sql: SELECT airport_from_id, COUNT( DISTINCT airport_to_id ) AS destination_count FROM /DMO/CONNECTION GROUP BY airport_from_id

question: How many distinct US cities have an airport listed?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT city ) AS city_count FROM /DMO/AIRPORT WHERE country = 'US'

question: Show the 10 flights with the most occupied seats, including airline codes, route numbers, dates and occupied seat counts. Sort by occupied seats, highest first, then by date, airline code and route number.
reference_sql: SELECT carrier_id, connection_id, flight_date, seats_occupied FROM /DMO/FLIGHT ORDER BY seats_occupied DESCENDING, flight_date ASCENDING, carrier_id ASCENDING, connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many flight bookings does each airline have, including airlines with none (show 0)? Show airline codes and booking counts.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, COUNT( b~carrier_id ) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/carrier AS c LEFT OUTER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~carrier_id = c~carrier_id GROUP BY c~carrier_id

question: Which units are used to record route distances? Show each unit code once.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT distance_unit FROM /DMO/CONNECTION

question: Break down trips by agency and status. Show agency numbers, status codes and trip counts for the 20 largest groups, highest count first, then by agency number and status code.
reference_sql: SELECT agency_id, status, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /DMO/TRAVEL GROUP BY agency_id, status ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, agency_id ASCENDING, status ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: How many extras added to bookings are priced in each currency? Show currency codes and extra counts.
reference_sql: SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS extra_count FROM /DMO/BOOK_SUPPL GROUP BY currency_code

question: For each airline that has listed routes, what are the earliest and latest departure times among those routes? Show airline codes and both times.
reference_sql: SELECT carrier_id, MIN( departure_time ) AS earliest_departure_time, MAX( departure_time ) AS latest_departure_time FROM /DMO/CONNECTION GROUP BY carrier_id

question: Show the 10 earliest-made bookings for flights in October 2026. Return trip IDs, booking numbers, booking dates, flight dates, passenger first and last names, and airline names, earliest booking date first, then by trip ID and booking number.
reference_sql: SELECT b~travel_id, b~booking_id, b~booking_date, b~flight_date, p~first_name, p~last_name, c~name FROM /dmo/booking AS b INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS p ON p~customer_id = b~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id WHERE b~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' ORDER BY b~booking_date ASCENDING, b~travel_id ASCENDING, b~booking_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 agency and airline combinations account for the most flight bookings? Return agency IDs and names, airline codes, and booking counts, most bookings first, then by agency ID and airline code.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, b~carrier_id, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name, b~carrier_id ORDER BY booking_count DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING, b~carrier_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Show the 10 most expensive trips priced in euros, with trip IDs, total prices, agency names, and the trip customers' first and last names. Sort by total price, highest first, then by trip ID.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~total_price, a~name, c~first_name, c~last_name FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/agency AS a ON a~agency_id = t~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS c ON c~customer_id = t~customer_id WHERE t~currency_code = 'EUR' ORDER BY t~total_price DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which agencies handled trips starting in all three months of the fourth quarter of 2026? Return agency numbers, names, and separate trip counts for October, November, and December.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS october_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261101' AND '20261130' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS november_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS december_trips FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) > 0 AND SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261101' AND '20261130' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) > 0 AND SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) > 0

question: Which customers have more trips marked booked than new? Return customer numbers, first and last names, and their booked and new trip counts.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS new_trips FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) > SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )

question: Which 20 customers have the highest combined prices for euro-priced trips, counting only customers who used at least two agencies for those trips? Return customer numbers, first and last names, trip counts, agency counts, and total prices in euros. Sort by total price, highest first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT( * ) AS trip_count, COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) AS agency_count, SUM( t~total_price ) AS total_eur FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id WHERE t~currency_code = 'EUR' GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) >= 2 ORDER BY total_eur DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: For each airline and distance unit with listed connections, show its longest connection, choosing the lowest connection number if tied. Return airline codes and names, connection numbers, departure and arrival airport codes, distances, and units. Sort by airline code, unit, then connection number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, a~name, c~connection_id, c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id, c~distance, c~distance_unit FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS a ON a~carrier_id = c~carrier_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT x~connection_id FROM /dmo/connection AS x WHERE x~carrier_id = c~carrier_id AND x~distance_unit = c~distance_unit AND ( x~distance > c~distance OR ( x~distance = c~distance AND x~connection_id < c~connection_id ) ) ) ORDER BY c~carrier_id ASCENDING, c~distance_unit ASCENDING, c~connection_id ASCENDING

question: At each departure airport that has flights scheduled in October 2026, which airline scheduled the most flights in October 2026? Include all airlines tied for first. Return airport codes and names, airline codes and names, and flight counts.
reference_sql: SELECT p~airport_id, p~name AS airport_name, a~carrier_id, a~name AS airline_name, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count FROM /dmo/flight AS f INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND c~connection_id = f~connection_id INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS p ON p~airport_id = c~airport_from_id INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS a ON a~carrier_id = f~carrier_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY p~airport_id, p~name, a~carrier_id, a~name HAVING COUNT( * ) >= ALL ( SELECT COUNT( * ) AS competing_count FROM /dmo/flight AS x INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS y ON y~carrier_id = x~carrier_id AND y~connection_id = x~connection_id WHERE y~airport_from_id = p~airport_id AND x~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY x~carrier_id )

question: For each currency, which traveler country spent the most on purchased extras? Include all countries tied for first. Return country codes, currencies, extra counts, and total charges.
reference_sql: SELECT c~country_code, s~currency_code, COUNT( * ) AS extra_count, SUM( s~price ) AS total_charges FROM /dmo/book_suppl AS s INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = s~travel_id AND b~booking_id = s~booking_id INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS c ON c~customer_id = b~customer_id GROUP BY c~country_code, s~currency_code HAVING SUM( s~price ) >= ALL ( SELECT SUM( x~price ) AS competing_total FROM /dmo/book_suppl AS x INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS y ON y~travel_id = x~travel_id AND y~booking_id = x~booking_id INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS z ON z~customer_id = y~customer_id WHERE x~currency_code = s~currency_code GROUP BY z~country_code )

question: Which 20 agencies had the widest range of booking lead times for flights departing in December 2026? Measure lead time as days from booking to departure. Return agency numbers, names, booking counts, shortest and longest lead times, and their difference. Sort by the difference, largest first, then agency number.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, COUNT( * ) AS booking_count, MIN( dats_days_between( b~booking_date, b~flight_date ) ) AS shortest_lead_days, MAX( dats_days_between( b~booking_date, b~flight_date ) ) AS longest_lead_days, MAX( dats_days_between( b~booking_date, b~flight_date ) ) - MIN( dats_days_between( b~booking_date, b~flight_date ) ) AS lead_range_days FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE b~flight_date BETWEEN '20261201' AND '20261231' GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name ORDER BY lead_range_days DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Among trips with multiple flight bookings to the same destination airport, which 20 have the most distinct destination airports? Return trip numbers, flight booking counts, and distinct destination counts. Sort by destination count, highest first, then trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT b~travel_id, COUNT( * ) AS booking_count, COUNT( DISTINCT c~airport_to_id ) AS destination_count FROM /dmo/booking AS b INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id AND c~connection_id = b~connection_id GROUP BY b~travel_id HAVING COUNT( * ) > COUNT( DISTINCT c~airport_to_id ) ORDER BY destination_count DESCENDING, b~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Among customers with no trips marked planned, which 20 have trips with flight bookings across the most airlines? Return customer numbers, first and last names, airline counts, and flight booking counts. Sort by airline count, highest first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT( DISTINCT b~carrier_id ) AS airline_count, COUNT( * ) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT x~travel_id FROM /dmo/travel AS x WHERE x~customer_id = c~customer_id AND x~status = 'P' ) GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY airline_count DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 customers have the most combined trip days for trips starting in April 2027? Add each trip's full duration, including its start and end dates, counting overlapping trips separately. Return customer numbers, first and last names, trip counts, and combined trip days. Sort by combined days, highest first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT( * ) AS trip_count, SUM( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) + 1 ) AS combined_trip_days FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20270401' AND '20270430' GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY combined_trip_days DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 10 cities have the most customers? Show cities, country codes and customer counts, largest count first, then by country code and city.
reference_sql: SELECT city, country_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM /DMO/CUSTOMER GROUP BY city, country_code ORDER BY customer_count DESCENDING, country_code ASCENDING, city ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /DMO/TRAVEL WHERE status IN ( 'B', 'P' )

question: Which 10 agency–customer pairs account for the most trips? Return agency IDs and names, customer IDs, first names and last names, and trip counts, most trips first, then by agency ID and customer ID.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/agency AS a ON a~agency_id = t~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS c ON c~customer_id = t~customer_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name, c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which cities have more than one listed airport? Return city names, country codes, and airport counts.
reference_sql: SELECT a~city, a~country, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM /dmo/airport AS a GROUP BY a~city, a~country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Which 20 customers have the most trips that overlap another of their trips, counting shared start or end dates as overlaps? Return customer numbers, first and last names, and overlapping-trip counts, highest count first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT(*) AS overlapping_trip_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /dmo/travel AS other WHERE other~customer_id = t~customer_id AND other~travel_id <> t~travel_id AND other~begin_date <= t~end_date AND other~end_date >= t~begin_date ) GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY overlapping_trip_count DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 agencies served the most customers who have also used another agency? Return agency numbers, names, distinct customer counts, and trip counts for those customers. Sort by customer count, highest first, then agency number.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, COUNT( DISTINCT t~customer_id ) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /dmo/travel AS other WHERE other~customer_id = t~customer_id AND other~agency_id <> t~agency_id ) GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name ORDER BY customer_count DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 trips with the lowest trip numbers have at least one flight booking and all their flight bookings priced in the trip's currency? Return trip numbers, currencies, and flight booking counts, sorted by trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id GROUP BY t~travel_id, t~currency_code HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN b~currency_code <> t~currency_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 0 ORDER BY t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: For each aircraft type used in October 2026, how many flights depart before noon and how many depart at noon or later? Return aircraft types and both flight counts.
reference_sql: SELECT f~plane_type_id, SUM( CASE WHEN n~departure_time < '120000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS before_noon_count, SUM( CASE WHEN n~departure_time >= '120000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS noon_or_later_count FROM /dmo/flight AS f INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS n ON n~carrier_id = f~carrier_id AND n~connection_id = f~connection_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY f~plane_type_id

question: Among trips starting in June 2026 with flight bookings, which 20 have the most days from the trip start to their first flight? Return trip numbers, start dates, first flight dates, and days until the first flight. Sort by days, highest first, then trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~begin_date, MIN( b~flight_date ) AS first_flight_date, MIN( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, b~flight_date ) ) AS days_until_first_flight FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20260601' AND '20260630' GROUP BY t~travel_id, t~begin_date ORDER BY days_until_first_flight DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 customers had the longest gap between consecutive distinct trip start dates? Treat trips starting on the same date as one start date. Return customer numbers, first and last names, and their longest gap in days, largest first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, MAX( dats_days_between( earlier~begin_date, later~begin_date ) ) AS longest_gap_days FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS earlier ON earlier~customer_id = c~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS later ON later~customer_id = c~customer_id AND later~begin_date > earlier~begin_date WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM /dmo/travel AS middle_trip WHERE middle_trip~customer_id = c~customer_id AND middle_trip~begin_date > earlier~begin_date AND middle_trip~begin_date < later~begin_date ) GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY longest_gap_days DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Within each extra category and purchase currency, which extra generated the highest total charges? Include all ties. Return category codes, currencies, extra codes, purchase counts, and total charges.
reference_sql: SELECT p~supplement_category, s~currency_code, s~supplement_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count, SUM( s~price ) AS total_charges FROM /dmo/book_suppl AS s INNER JOIN /dmo/supplement AS p ON p~supplement_id = s~supplement_id GROUP BY p~supplement_category, s~currency_code, s~supplement_id HAVING SUM( s~price ) >= ALL ( SELECT SUM( other~price ) FROM /dmo/book_suppl AS other INNER JOIN /dmo/supplement AS other_product ON other_product~supplement_id = other~supplement_id WHERE other_product~supplement_category = p~supplement_category AND other~currency_code = s~currency_code GROUP BY other~supplement_id )

question: Which 20 customers have the greatest difference between their longest and shortest trips? Measure each trip as the days between its start and end. Return customer numbers, first and last names, shortest and longest durations, and their difference. Sort by the difference, largest first, then customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, MIN( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) ) AS shortest_days, MAX( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) ) AS longest_days, MAX( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) ) - MIN( dats_days_between( t~begin_date, t~end_date ) ) AS duration_difference FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name ORDER BY duration_difference DESCENDING, c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 agencies have the highest percentage of trips marked booked? Return agency numbers, names, total trip counts, booked trip counts, and percentages rounded to 2 decimals. Sort by the rounded percentage, highest first, then agency number.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trip_count, division( 100 * SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), COUNT(*), 2 ) AS booked_percentage FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name ORDER BY booked_percentage DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 20 trips have the largest booking fee as a percentage of their total price? Return trip numbers, currencies, booking fees, total prices, and percentages rounded to 2 decimals. Sort by the rounded percentage, highest first, then trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~currency_code, t~booking_fee, t~total_price, division( 100 * t~booking_fee, t~total_price, 2 ) AS booking_fee_percentage FROM /dmo/travel AS t ORDER BY booking_fee_percentage DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 10 customers have trips through the most different agencies? Show customer numbers and agency counts, highest count first, then by customer number.

question: Which 10 trips have the most extras added to their bookings? Show trip numbers and extra counts, highest count first, then by trip number.
reference_sql: SELECT travel_id, COUNT(*) AS extra_count FROM /DMO/BOOK_SUPPL GROUP BY travel_id ORDER BY extra_count DESCENDING, travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 customers have bookings for the most distinct flight dates? Show customer numbers and date counts, highest count first, then by customer number.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT( DISTINCT flight_date ) AS flight_date_count FROM /DMO/BOOKING GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY flight_date_count DESCENDING, customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: For each country with domestic connections, show its country code, connection count, and number of different departure airports. Count each airline's numbered connection separately.
reference_sql: SELECT d~country, COUNT(*) AS connection_count, COUNT( DISTINCT c~airport_from_id ) AS departure_airport_count FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS d ON d~airport_id = c~airport_from_id INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS a ON a~airport_id = c~airport_to_id WHERE d~country = a~country GROUP BY d~country

question: Which 10 agency locations account for the most trips? Return city names, country codes, trip counts, and the number of agencies handling those trips, most trips first, then by country code and city name.
reference_sql: SELECT a~city, a~country_code, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, COUNT( DISTINCT a~agency_id ) AS agency_count FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id GROUP BY a~city, a~country_code ORDER BY trip_count DESCENDING, a~country_code ASCENDING, a~city ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: For each passenger home country represented in add-on purchases, show the country code, number of purchased add-on entries, number of different add-ons, and number of passengers who purchased them.
reference_sql: SELECT c~country_code, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COUNT( DISTINCT s~supplement_id ) AS addon_count, COUNT( DISTINCT c~customer_id ) AS passenger_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS s ON s~travel_id = b~travel_id AND s~booking_id = b~booking_id GROUP BY c~country_code

question: How much has been charged for add-ons on each airline's bookings, for airlines with purchased add-ons, separately by currency? Return airline codes and names, currency codes, purchased entry counts, and total add-on charges.
reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~name, s~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, SUM( s~price ) AS total_addon_charges FROM /dmo/carrier AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~carrier_id = c~carrier_id INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS s ON s~travel_id = b~travel_id AND s~booking_id = b~booking_id GROUP BY c~carrier_id, c~name, s~currency_code

question: Which 10 agencies have arranged bookings on the widest variety of aircraft types? Return agency IDs and aircraft type counts, most types first, then by agency ID.
reference_sql: SELECT t~agency_id, COUNT( DISTINCT f~plane_type_id ) AS aircraft_type_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = b~carrier_id AND f~connection_id = b~connection_id AND f~flight_date = b~flight_date GROUP BY t~agency_id ORDER BY aircraft_type_count DESCENDING, t~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many flights are scheduled at each departure time of day in October 2026? Return departure times, flight counts, and airline counts, earliest time first.
reference_sql: SELECT c~departure_time, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, COUNT( DISTINCT f~carrier_id ) AS airline_count FROM /dmo/connection AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/flight AS f ON f~carrier_id = c~carrier_id AND f~connection_id = c~connection_id WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY c~departure_time ORDER BY c~departure_time ASCENDING

question: For every airport, show its code and name, how many different airports its listed connections depart to, and how many different airports have listed connections arriving there. Include airports with no connections.
reference_sql: SELECT a~airport_id, a~name, COUNT( DISTINCT outgoing~airport_to_id ) AS destination_count, COUNT( DISTINCT incoming~airport_from_id ) AS origin_count FROM /dmo/airport AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN /dmo/connection AS outgoing ON outgoing~airport_from_id = a~airport_id LEFT OUTER JOIN /dmo/connection AS incoming ON incoming~airport_to_id = a~airport_id GROUP BY a~airport_id, a~name

question: For each passenger home country with flight bookings, show the country code, earliest and latest booking dates, and number of different dates on which bookings were made.
reference_sql: SELECT c~country_code, MIN( b~booking_date ) AS earliest_booking_date, MAX( b~booking_date ) AS latest_booking_date, COUNT( DISTINCT b~booking_date ) AS booking_date_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~country_code

question: Which 10 trips include flights on the most different dates? Return trip IDs, agency names, flight-date counts, and first and last flight dates, most dates first, then by trip ID.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, a~name, COUNT( DISTINCT b~flight_date ) AS flight_date_count, MIN( b~flight_date ) AS first_flight_date, MAX( b~flight_date ) AS last_flight_date FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/agency AS a ON a~agency_id = t~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id GROUP BY t~travel_id, a~name ORDER BY flight_date_count DESCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: Which 10 pairs of different agencies share the most trip customers? Return each pair once, with the lower agency ID first, and the shared-customer count. Sort by most shared customers, then by the first and second agency IDs.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id AS first_agency_id, b~agency_id AS second_agency_id, COUNT( DISTINCT a~customer_id ) AS shared_customer_count FROM /dmo/travel AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS b ON b~customer_id = a~customer_id AND a~agency_id < b~agency_id GROUP BY a~agency_id, b~agency_id ORDER BY shared_customer_count DESCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING, b~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: For trips starting in the fourth quarter of 2026, show each traveler country and its numbers of booked, planned, and new trips.
reference_sql: SELECT c~country_code, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS booked_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS planned_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS new_trips FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/customer AS c ON c~customer_id = t~customer_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261231' GROUP BY c~country_code

question: Show the first 20 October 2026 flights with bookings through at least two agencies, ordered by departure date, airline code, then connection number. Return those flight details, airline names, agency counts, and booking counts.
reference_sql: SELECT b~flight_date, b~carrier_id, b~connection_id, c~name, COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) AS agency_count, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/booking AS b INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~travel_id = b~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS c ON c~carrier_id = b~carrier_id WHERE b~flight_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY b~flight_date, b~carrier_id, b~connection_id, c~name HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT t~agency_id ) >= 2 ORDER BY b~flight_date ASCENDING, b~carrier_id ASCENDING, b~connection_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which customers have flight bookings priced in at least three currencies? Return customer numbers, first and last names, currency counts, and booking counts.
reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, COUNT( DISTINCT b~currency_code ) AS currency_count, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~customer_id = c~customer_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT b~currency_code ) >= 3

question: Which extras were purchased on more than one flight booking within the same trip starting in October 2026? Return trip numbers, extra codes, the number of bookings containing each extra, and its purchase count.
reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, s~supplement_id, COUNT( DISTINCT s~booking_id ) AS booking_count, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count FROM /dmo/travel AS t INNER JOIN /dmo/book_suppl AS s ON s~travel_id = t~travel_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY t~travel_id, s~supplement_id HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT s~booking_id ) > 1

question: Which agencies arranged flights to at least three destination countries for trips starting in October 2026? Return agency numbers, names, destination-country counts, destination-airport counts, and flight-booking counts.
reference_sql: SELECT a~agency_id, a~name, COUNT( DISTINCT p~country ) AS destination_country_count, COUNT( DISTINCT p~airport_id ) AS destination_airport_count, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/agency AS a INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~agency_id = a~agency_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS n ON n~carrier_id = b~carrier_id AND n~connection_id = b~connection_id INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS p ON p~airport_id = n~airport_to_id WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261031' GROUP BY a~agency_id, a~name HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT p~country ) >= 3

question: For each status, how many trips overlap October 2026, including their start and end dates? Return status codes, total overlapping trips, and separate counts for those starting in October and those starting earlier.
reference_sql: SELECT t~status, COUNT(*) AS overlapping_trips, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date >= '20261001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS starting_in_october, SUM( CASE WHEN t~begin_date < '20261001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS starting_earlier FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~begin_date <= '20261031' AND t~end_date >= '20261001' GROUP BY t~status

question: For trips starting in the fourth quarter of 2026, show total trip prices separately for trips ending before 2027 and those continuing into 2027 or beyond. Return each currency and both totals, keeping currencies separate.
reference_sql: SELECT t~currency_code, SUM( CASE WHEN t~end_date < '20270101' THEN t~total_price ELSE 0 END ) AS ending_before_2027_total, SUM( CASE WHEN t~end_date >= '20270101' THEN t~total_price ELSE 0 END ) AS continuing_into_2027_total FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~begin_date BETWEEN '20261001' AND '20261231' GROUP BY t~currency_code

question: Which customers have trips containing flights to the same destination airport on at least three separate trips? reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, p~airport_id, p~name, COUNT( DISTINCT t~travel_id ) AS trip_count, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /dmo/customer AS c INNER JOIN /dmo/travel AS t ON t~customer_id = c~customer_id INNER JOIN /dmo/booking AS b ON b~travel_id = t~travel_id INNER JOIN /dmo/connection AS n ON n~carrier_id = b~carrier_id AND n~connection_id = b~connection_id INNER JOIN /dmo/airport AS p ON p~airport_id = n~airport_to_id GROUP BY c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, p~airport_id, p~name HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT t~travel_id ) >= 3 ORDER BY c~customer_id ASCENDING, p~airport_id ASCENDING UP TO 20 ROWS

question: Which 10 customers have the most flight bookings? Show customer numbers and booking counts, largest count first, then by customer number.

question: Which 5 airports have the most routes arriving at them? Show airport codes and route counts, largest count first, then by airport code.

question: How many flight bookings are priced in each currency? Show currency codes and booking counts.
reference_sql: SELECT b~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM /DMO/BOOKING AS b GROUP BY b~currency_code

question: What are the 10 most common booking fee and currency combinations for trips? Show fees, currency codes and trip counts, largest count first, then by currency code and lowest fee.

question: What are the 10 most common ticket price and currency combinations in the flight schedule? Show prices, currency codes and flight counts, largest count first, then by currency code and lowest price.
reference_sql: SELECT f~price, f~currency_code, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM /DMO/FLIGHT AS f GROUP BY f~price, f~currency_code ORDER BY flight_count DESCENDING, f~currency_code ASCENDING, f~price ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

question: How many different airlines use each aircraft type in the flight schedule? Show aircraft types and airline counts.

question: For each category of available extras, how many different prices are offered in each currency? Show category codes, currency codes and distinct price counts.
